mentions.name: Barcode scanner card sub-organizing setup
mentions.description: A trading card collection organizing setup, similar to MyBulkCards, that sub-organizes cards quickly using a Zebra TC53 device with its barcode scanner, integrated with a ZQ620 label printer for labeling.
mentions.source_excerpt: I did something similar, and went as far as integrating a label printer (ZQ620) and use a TC53 with the barcode scanner to sub organize quickly :x.
